A '''stadium''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. It consisted of a central arena covered with a floating canopy, surrounded by seats. Outside were stone pillars, as well as stone steps leading inside. Privileged guests sat in booths higher up than the regular seats. On warm days, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-powered sunshades floated above the crowds to block out the [[Star/Legends|sun]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] considered the stadium to be enormous, and it was visible to [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] as her [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] approached the city from [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], the stadium was the site of a [[Ssi-ruu]]vi [[Consecration Ceremony]] that preceded the [[Battle of Bakura (28 ABY)|battle at Bakura]].
